croll.title: BLACK TORCH Anime Announces 2 More Cast Members
croll.description: The adaptation of Tsuyoshi Takaki's manga premieres in July 2026
croll.content: More cast members for characters belonging to the Bureau of Espionage were announced today for the upcoming  BLACK TORCH  TV anime, based on the manga of the same name by Tsuyoshi Takaki.  At the Jump Festa 2026 stage event for the series, Ryosuke Shiba and his underling Hana Usami had their voice actors announced alongside the first look at their anime character designs. mal.title: 'Black Torch' Announces Additional Cast Pair
mal.description: The Black Torch presentation at Jump Festa 2026's Jump Station announced a pair of additional cast on Sunday. The anime, adapting Tsuyoshi Takaki's action supernatural manga, is scheduled to premiere in July 2026. Ryousuke Shiba: Junichi Suwabe (Black Clover) Hana Usami: Reina Ueda (Chainsaw Man) Kei Umabiki (Kono Sekai wa Fukanzen Sugiru) is helming the anime at 100studio.
